summary: Full backend+frontend verification of Phase 4 (Inventory & Equipment) and 'Active Perks' panel on Business Manage. Backend: 7/7 pytest assertions PASS (test_inventory_equipment.py) — GET /api/shop/items lists all new items (energy_drink, first_aid_kit, sleeping_pills, nice_clothes, business_suit, luxury_watch, toolbelt, athletic_gear) and legacy 'gift' is REMOVED; GET /api/equipment returns exactly the 5 slots {outfit, accessory, phone, computer, work_gear} plus bonuses; GET /api/inventory correctly flags each item with usable/equippable/equipped; POST /api/inventory/nice_clothes/equip → outfit slot filled + aggregate bonuses {social_status_floor≥12, social_success≥0.05, tip_rate≥0.03}; POST /api/equipment/outfit/unequip → slot empties + bonuses drop; slot replacement (nice_clothes then business_suit into 'outfit') works — only business_suit ends equipped; POST /api/inventory/nice_clothes/use returns 400 with 'equip it instead' message (equipment gating); POST /api/inventory/energy_drink/use decrements qty by 1; dovan has no wage/material social perks. Frontend (live https://grind-nation.preview.emergentagent.com, mara@kaeldor.com/demo123 + dovan@kaeldor.com/demo123): /shop renders data-testid='equipment-panel' with all 5 equip-slot-<id> tiles; category headings CONSUMABLES/APPAREL/ACCESSORIES/DEVICES/WORK & FITNESS GEAR present; buy-energy_drink → inv-item-energy_drink appears with use-energy_drink button and NO equip button; equippable items (nice_clothes, business_suit) show equip-<id> and NO use-<id> button; clicking equip-nice_clothes fills outfit slot with 'Nice Outfit' + bonus pills (Social status ≥12, +5% social success, +3% tips), inventory card gets equipped-tag-nice_clothes, 'Active passive bonuses' summary shows aggregated pills, and unequip-outfit becomes present; then equipping business_suit REPLACES nice_clothes in the outfit slot (equipped-tag-business_suit appears, equipped-tag-nice_clothes disappears, slot now shows business_suit + its bonus pills). Dovan's /businesses/{kiosk} Overview shows data-testid='active-perks-panel' with data-testid='active-perks-empty' hint text 'No active perks yet. Meet a Manager or Wholesaler (Social ▸ Meet People), then use Talk Business to unlock permanent wage / material discounts.'; pnl-footer still renders (P&L intact); Messages page still gated by device ownership (mara has both, page loads). Zero console errors on Shop, Dashboard, Messages, BusinessManage.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _recompute_equip_bonus correctly aggregates: floors take max, *_mult multiply, rest sum — verified via nice_clothes → business_suit replacement (bonuses reset when slot swaps).
/api/inventory/{item_id}/use enforces category=='consumable' with a clear 400 message ('This item is equipment — equip it instead of using it.') — good UX gating.
Shop.jsx conditionally renders Equip vs Use button based on backend equippable/usable flags (verified: no cross-buttons appear). Equipped state is source-of-truth from GET /api/equipment.
BusinessManage.jsx ActivePerks empty-state hint copy is user-friendly and points players to the exact flow to unlock perks (Social ▸ Meet People + Talk Business).
Minor code hygiene (not blocking): server.py is 2932 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting inventory/equipment/shop endpoints into a router module in a future pass.

Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env exported (or use the value from /app/frontend/.env).
